name: BeneficiaryCaseManager
tagline: Case management for nonprofit programmes – referrals, consent, needs, case plans, services, reviews and caseloads in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete beneficiary case management app: referrals and intake with consent gates, a five-domain needs assessment, case plan goals with progress, services and case notes, review scheduling, On hold and closure with reasons and outcome rates, weighted caseloads with balancing suggestions, and funder-ready KPIs. Works in demo mode immediately and binds to Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL with column dropdowns.
features: Referral → Intake → Assessment → Active → On hold → Closed with gates
Case plan goals with tick-to-achieve progress
Services and case notes, bulk logging for group sessions
Review calendar with overdue and reschedule
